title: Normalized finite-stage purity adjunction on the lifted PBC categories
statement: Fix finite-field datum D of characteristic p, prime l≠p, and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. Let X,Y be separated finite-type D.k-schemes and f:X→Y smooth separated of pure relative dimension d, with a compactification c. Use their Noetherian, dimension and invertibility bounds and the actual functors P_E,H_E and normalized scalar maps A,C of [def-pur-rational-purity-scalar-models]. There exist adjunctions P_E⊣H_E simultaneously for every finite coefficient stage E⊂Ω. For E≤F and K in the rational stage over Y, their counits satisfy P_F(A(h)_K) ≫ ε_F(T_Y(h)K) = C(h)⁻¹_(H_E K) ≫ T_Y(h)(ε_E(K)). The comparisons are the specified completed PBC comparisons, not extra chosen maps. This asserts only finite-stage adjunction and its counit square; it asserts no coherence, descent or retract conclusion.

proof.text: Identify the integral lattice predicates with complete finite-Tor constructibility and use simultaneous integral purity. Transport the exceptional adjunction across its integral purity isomorphism. The coefficient square and counit-mate normalization identify the transported coefficient comparison with the fixed twisted comparison.

Localize the integral Hom bijections and their triangle equations. Scalar fractions extend their naturality to all rational arrows. Conjugate the counit square by the unique stage normalizations to obtain exactly A and C of the statement.

theorem pbcPurityFiniteAdjunction :
    ∃ adj : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω,
      pbcPurityStageCompact l Ω f c d E ⊣ pbcPurityStageTwisted l Ω f c d E,
    ∀ {E F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ F)
      (K : pbcStageCategory l Ω Y E),
      (pbcPurityStageCompact l Ω f c d F).map
          ((pbcPurityStageA l Ω f c d h).hom.app K) ≫
          (adj F).counit.app (((pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out).T h).obj K) =
        (pbcPurityStageC l Ω f c d h).inv.app
            ((pbcPurityStageTwisted l Ω f c d E).obj K) ≫
          ((pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out).T h).map ((adj E).counit.app K)
